segments.t: اللَّهُمَّ رَبَّنَا آتِنَا فِي الدُّنْيَا حَسَنَةً، وَفِي الْآخِرَةِ حَسَنَةً، وَقِنَا عَذَابَ النَّارِ.
(مُتَّفَقٌ عَلَيْهِ)

items.textEn: O Allah, our Lord, grant us good in this world and good in the Hereafter, and protect us from the punishment of the Fire.
items.translit:
Allahumma rabbana atina fid-dunya hasanah,

Wa fil-akhirati hasanah,

Wa qina ‘adhaban-nar.

segments.t: اللَّهُمَّ آتِ نَفْسِي تَقْوَاهَا، وَزَكِّهَا أَنْتَ خَيْرُ مَن زَكَّاهَا، أَنْتَ وَلِيُّهَا وَمَوْلَاهَا، اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ عِلْمٍ لَا يَنْفَعُ، وَمِنْ قَلْبٍ لَا يَخْشَعُ، وَمِنْ نَفْسٍ لَا تَشْبَعُ، وَمِنْ دَعْوَةٍ لَا يُسْتَجَابُ لَهَا.
(رواه مسلم)

items.textEn:
O Allah, grant my soul its piety and purify it, for You are the best to purify it. You are its Guardian and Protector.
O Allah, I seek refuge in You from knowledge that does not benefit, from a heart that does not humble, from a soul that is never satisfied, and from a supplication that is not answered.
items.translit:
Allahumma ati nafsi taqwaha,

Wa zakkiha anta khayru man zakkaha,

Anta waliyyuha wa mawlaha,

Allahumma inni a‘udhu bika min ‘ilmin la yanfa‘,

Wa min qalbin la yakhsha‘,

Wa min nafsin la tashba‘,

Wa min da‘watin la yustajabu laha.

segments.t: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا عَمِلْتُ، وَشَرِّ مَا لَمْ أَعْمَلْ.
(رواه مسلم)

items.textEn: O Allah, I seek refuge in You from the evil of what I have done and from the evil of what I have not done.
items.translit:
Allahumma inni a‘udhu bika min sharri ma ‘amiltu,

Wa sharri ma lam a‘mal.

segments.t: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ زَوَالِ نِعْمَتِكَ، وَتَحَوُّلِ عَافِيَتِكَ، وَفُجَاءَةِ نِقْمَتِكَ، وَجَمِيعِ سَخَطِكَ.
(رواه مسلم)

items.textEn: O Allah, I seek refuge in You from the loss of Your blessings, the change of Your protection, the suddenness of Your punishment, and all forms of Your displeasure.
items.translit:
Allahumma inni a‘udhu bika min zawali ni‘matik,

Wa tahawwuli ‘afiyatik,

Wa fuja’ati niqmatik,

Wa jami‘i sakhatik.

segments.t: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْهَدْمِ، وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ التَّرَدِّي، وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْغَرَقِ، وَالْحَرْقِ، وَالْهَرَمِ، وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ أَنْ يَتَخَبَّطَنِيَ الشَّيْطَانُ عِنْدَ الْمَوْتِ، وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ أَنْ أَمُوتَ فِي سَبِيلِكَ مُدْبِرًا، وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ أَنْ أَمُوتَ لَدِيغًا.
(رواه النسائي، وأبو داود)

items.textEn:
O Allah, I seek refuge in You from being destroyed by a collapse, from falling from a height, from drowning, burning, or old age.
I seek refuge in You from being overcome by Satan at the time of death, from turning my back in battle, and from dying due to a poisonous bite.
items.translit:
Allahumma inni a‘udhu bika minal-hadmi,

Wa a‘udhu bika minat-tarradi,

Wa a‘udhu bika minal-gharqi wal-harqi wal-haram,

Wa a‘udhu bika an yatakhabbataniya ash-shaytanu ‘indal-mawt,

Wa a‘udhu bika an amuta fi sabilika mudbiran,

Wa a‘udhu bika an amuta ladighan.

segments.t:
اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ فِتْنَةِ النَّارِ وَعَذَابِ النَّارِ، وَفِتْنَةِ الْقَبْرِ، وَعَذَابِ الْقَبْرِ، وَشَرِّ فِتْنَةِ الْغِنَى، وَشَرِّ فِتْنَةِ الْفَقْرِ، اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّ فِتْنَةِ الْمَسِيحِ الدَّجَّالِ، اللَّهُمَّ اغْسِلْ قَلْبِي بِمَاءِ الثَّلْجِ وَالْبَرَدِ، وَنَقِّ قَلْبِي مِنْ الْخَطَايَا كَمَا نَقَّيْتَ الثَّوْبَ الْأَبْيَضَ مِنْ الدَّنَسِ، وَبَاعِدْ بَيْنِي وَبَيْنَ خَطَايَايَ كَمَا بَاعَدْتَ بَيْنَ الْمَشْرِقِ وَالْمَغْرِبِ.
اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ الْكَسَلِ وَالْمَأْثَمِ وَالْمَغْرَمِ.
(متفق عليه)

items.textEn:
O Allah, I seek refuge in You from the trial of the Fire and the torment of the Fire, from the trial of the grave and the punishment of the grave, from the evil of the trial of wealth and the evil of the trial of poverty.

O Allah, I seek refuge in You from the evil of the trial of the False Messiah (Al-Masih Ad-Dajjal).

O Allah, wash my heart with water, snow, and hail, and cleanse it of sins as a white garment is cleansed of dirt.

O Allah, distance me from my sins as You have distanced the East from the West.

O Allah, I seek refuge in You from laziness, sin, and heavy debt.
items.translit:
Allahumma inni a‘udhu bika min fitnatin-nar wa ‘adhabin-nar,

Wa fitnatil-qabri wa ‘adhabil-qabr,

Wa sharri fitnatil-ghina wa sharri fitnatil-faqr,

Allahumma inni a‘udhu bika min sharri fitnatil-masihid-dajjal,

Allahumma aghsil qalbi bima’ith-thalji wal-barad,

Wa naqqi qalbi minal-khataya kama naqqayta ath-thawbal-abyada minad-danas,

Wa ba‘id bayni wa bayna khatayaya kama ba‘adta baynal-mashriqi wal-maghrib,

Allahumma inni a‘udhu bika minal-kasali wal-ma’thami wal-maghram.

segments.t: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْعَجْزِ، وَالْكَسَلِ، وَالْجُبْنِ، وَالْهَرَمِ، وَالْبُخْلِ، وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ عَذَابِ الْقَبْرِ، وَمِنْ فِتْنَةِ الْمَحْيَا وَالْمَمَاتِ.
(متفق عليه)

items.textEn:
O Allah, I seek refuge in You from incapacity, laziness, cowardice, senility, and miserliness.

I seek refuge in You from the torment of the grave and from the trials of life and death.
items.translit:
Allahumma inni a‘udhu bika minal-‘ajzi wal-kasal,

Wal-jubni wal-haram wal-bukhl,

Wa a‘udhu bika min ‘adhabil-qabr,

Wa min fitnatil-mahya wal-mamat.

segments.t: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ جَهْدِ الْبَلَاءِ، وَدَرَكِ الشَّقَاءِ، وَسُوءِ الْقَضَاءِ، وَشَمَاتَةِ الْأَعْدَاءِ.
(متفق عليه)

items.textEn: O Allah, I seek refuge in You from severe trials, from falling into misery, from a bad decree, and from the gloating of enemies.
items.translit:
Allahumma inni a‘udhu bika min jahdil-bala’,

Wa darakish-shaqa’,

Wa su’il-qada’,

Wa shamātatil-a‘da’.

segments.t: اللَّهُمَّ أَصْلِحْ لِي دِينِي الَّذِي هُوَ عِصْمَةُ أَمْرِي، وَأَصْلِحْ لِي دُنْيَايَ الَّتِي فِيهَا مَعَاشِي، وَأَصْلِحْ لِي آخِرَتِي الَّتِي فِيهَا مَعَادِي، وَاجْعَلِ الْحَيَاةَ زِيَادَةً لِي فِي كُلِّ خَيْرٍ، وَاجْعَلِ الْمَوْتَ رَاحَةً لِي مِنْ كُلِّ شَرٍّ.
(رواه مسلم)

items.textEn:
O Allah, make my religion, which is the safeguard of my affairs, good for me.

Make my worldly life, in which is my living, good for me.

Make my Hereafter, to which is my return, good for me.

Make life an increase for me in all that is good, and make death a relief for me from all evil.
items.translit:
Allahumma aslih li dini alladhi huwa ‘ismatu amri,

Wa aslih li dunyaya allati fiha ma‘ashi,

Wa aslih li akhirati allati fiha ma‘adi,

Waj‘alil-hayata ziyadatan li fi kulli khayr,

Waj‘alil-mawta rahatan li min kulli sharr.

segments.t: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ الْهُدَى، وَالتُّقَى، وَالْعَفَافَ، وَالْغِنَى.
(رواه مسلم)

items.textEn: O Allah, I ask You for guidance, piety, chastity, and sufficiency.
items.translit:
Allahumma inni as’aluka al-huda,

Wat-tuqa,

Wal-‘afafa,

Wal-ghina.

segments.t: اللَّهُمَّ اهْدِنِي، وَسَدِّدْنِي، اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ الْهُدَى وَالسَّدَادَ.
(رواه مسلم)

items.textEn: O Allah, guide me and make me steadfast. O Allah, I ask You for guidance and sound judgment.
items.translit:
Allahumma ihdini wa saddidni,

Allahumma inni as’aluka al-huda was-sadad.

segments.t: اللَّهُمَّ أَكْثِرْ مَالِي، وَوَلَدِي، وَبَارِكْ لِي فِيمَا أَعْطَيْتَنِي.
يَدُلُّ عَلَيْهِ دُعَاءُ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ لِأَنَسٍ:
اللَّهُمَّ أَكْثِرْ مَالَهُ، وَوَلَدَهُ، وَبَارِكْ لَهُ فِيمَا أَعْطَيْتَهُ.
(متفق عليه)
وَأَطِلْ حَيَاتِي عَلَى طَاعَتِكَ، وَأَحْسِنْ عَمَلِي، وَاغْفِرْ لِي.
(البخاري في الأدب المفرد)

items.textEn:
O Allah, increase my wealth and children, and bless me in what You have given me.
This is indicated by the supplication of the Prophet ﷺ for Anas:
“O Allah, increase his wealth and children, and bless him in what You have given him.”
O Allah, prolong my life in obedience to You, make my deeds righteous, and forgive me.
items.translit:
Allahumma akthir mali wa waladi,

Wa barik li fima a‘taytani.

Wa atil hayati ‘ala ta‘atik,

Wa ahsin ‘amali,

Waghfir li.

segments.t: لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ الْعَظِيمُ الْحَلِيمُ، لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ رَبُّ الْعَرْشِ الْعَظِيمِ، لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ رَبُّ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَرَبُّ الْأَرْضِ، وَرَبُّ الْعَرْشِ الْكَرِيمِ.
كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ يَقُولُ هَذَا الدُّعَاءَ عِنْدَ الْكَرْبِ. (متفق عليه)

items.textEn:
There is no deity but Allah, the Great, the Forbearing.
There is no deity but Allah, Lord of the Mighty Throne.
There is no deity but Allah, Lord of the heavens, Lord of the earth, and Lord of the Noble Throne.
The Messenger of Allah ﷺ used to say this supplication during times of distress.
items.translit:
La ilaha illallahu al-‘azimu al-halim,

La ilaha illallahu rabbul-‘arshil-‘azim,

La ilaha illallahu rabbus-samawati wa rabbul-ardh,

Wa rabbul-‘arshil-karim.

segments.t: اللَّهُمَّ رَحْمَتَكَ أَرْجُو، فَلَا تَكِلْنِي إِلَى نَفْسِي طَرْفَةَ عَيْنٍ، وَأَصْلِحْ لِي شَأْنِي كُلَّهُ، لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ.
(رواه أبو داود، وأحمد وحسنه الألباني وغيره)

items.textEn: O Allah, I hope for Your mercy, so do not leave me to myself even for the blink of an eye. Rectify all of my affairs. There is no deity but You.
items.translit:
Allahumma rahmataka arju,

Fala takilni ila nafsi tarfata ‘ayn,

Wa aslih li sha’ni kullah,

La ilaha illa ant.

segments.t: لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ سُبْحَانَكَ إِنِّي كُنْتُ مِنَ الظَّالِمِينَ.

ولَفْظُهُ: دَعْوَةُ ذِي النُّونِ إِذْ دَعَا وَهُوَ فِي بَطْنِ الْحُوتِ: لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ سُبْحَانَكَ إِنِّي كُنْتُ مِنَ الظَّالِمِينَ، فَإِنَّهُ لَمْ يَدْعُ بِهَا رَجُلٌ مُسْلِمٌ فِي شَيْءٍ قَطُّ إِلَّا اسْتَجَابَ اللَّهُ لَهُ.

(رواه الترمذي والحاكم وصححه ووافقه الذهبي)

items.textEn:
There is no deity but You; glory be to You! Indeed, I have been of the wrongdoers.
This was the supplication of Prophet Yunus (Dhul-Nun) when he called upon Allah from within the belly of the whale.
No Muslim ever supplicates with these words for anything except that Allah answers him.
items.translit:
La ilaha illa anta subhanaka,

Inni kuntu mina az-zalimin.

segments.t: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي عَبْدُكَ، ابْنُ عَبْدِكَ، ابْنُ أَمَتِكَ، نَاصِيَتِي بِيَدِكَ، مَاضٍ فِيَّ حُكْمُكَ، عَدْلٌ فِيَّ قَضَاؤُكَ، أَسْأَلُكَ بِكُلِّ اسْمٍ هُوَ لَكَ، سَمَّيْتَ بِهِ نَفْسَكَ، أَوْ عَلَّمْتَهُ أَحَدًا مِنْ خَلْقِكَ، أَوْ أَنْزَلْتَهُ فِي كِتَابِكَ، أَوِ اسْتَأْثَرْتَ بِهِ فِي عِلْمِ الْغَيْبِ عِنْدَكَ، أَنْ تَجْعَلَ الْقُرْآنَ رَبِيعَ قَلْبِي، وَنُورَ صَدْرِي، وَجَلَاءَ حُزْنِي، وَذَهَابَ هَمِّي.
(رواه أحمد والحاكم وحسنه الحافظ في تخريج الأذكار، وصححه الألباني)

items.textEn:
O Allah, I am Your servant, son of Your servant, son of Your maidservant. My forelock is in Your hand; Your command over me is forever executed and Your decree over me is just.
I ask You by every name belonging to You which You have named Yourself with, revealed in Your Book, taught to any of Your creation, or kept unto Yourself in the knowledge of the unseen,
to make the Qur’an the spring of my heart, the light of my chest, the banisher of my sadness, and the reliever of my distress.
items.translit:
Allahumma inni ‘abduka, ibnu ‘abdika, ibnu amatika,

Nāsiyati biyadik, mādin fiyya hukmuk, ‘adlun fiyya qada’uk,

As’aluka bikulli ismin huwa lak, sammaita bihi nafsak,

Aw ‘allamtahu ahadan min khalqik, aw anzaltahu fi kitabik,

Aw ista’tharta bihi fi ‘ilmil-ghaybi ‘indak,

An taj‘alal-Qur’ana rabī‘a qalbi, wa nūra sadri,

Wa jalā’a huzni, wa dhahāba hammi.

segments.t: اللَّهُمَّ مُصَرِّفَ الْقُلُوبِ صَرِّفْ قُلُوبَنَا عَلَى طَاعَتِكَ.
(رواه مسلم)

items.textEn: O Allah, Controller of the hearts, direct our hearts toward Your obedience.
items.translit: Allahumma musarrifal-qulubi, sarrif qulubana ‘ala ta‘atik.

segments.t: يَا مُقَلِّبَ الْقُلُوبِ، ثَبِّتْ قَلْبِي عَلَى دِينِكَ.
(رواه الترمذي وأحمد والحاكم وصححه ووافقه الذهبي). وقد قالت أم سلمة رضي الله عنها: كان أكثرَ دعائه ﷺ.

items.textEn:
O Turner of the hearts, keep my heart firm upon Your religion.
Umm Salamah (may Allah be pleased with her) said: This was one of the most frequent supplications of the Prophet ﷺ.
items.translit:
Ya muqallibal-qulub,

Thabbit qalbi ‘ala dinik.

segments.t: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ الْعَافِيَةَ فِي الدُّنْيَا وَالآخِرَةِ.
(رواه الترمذي ولفظه: سلوا الله العافية في الدنيا والآخرة، وفي لفظٍ آخر: سلوا الله العفو والعافية، فإن أحدًا لم يُعْطَ بعد اليقين خيرًا من العافية).

items.textEn:
O Allah, I ask You for well-being in this world and in the Hereafter.
(The Prophet ﷺ said: Ask Allah for well-being in this world and the Hereafter, for no one is given anything after certainty better than well-being.)
items.translit: Allahumma inni as’aluka al-‘afiyata fid-dunya wal-akhirah.

segments.t: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ الْعَافِيَةَ فِي الدُّنْيَا وَالْآخِرَةِ، اللَّهُمَّ أَسْأَلُكَ الْعَفْوَ وَالْعَافِيَةَ فِي دِينِي وَدُنْيَايَ وَأَهْلِي وَمَالِي، اللَّهُمَّ اسْتُرْ عَوْرَاتِي وَآمِنْ رَوْعَاتِي، اللَّهُمَّ احْفَظْنِي مِنْ بَيْنِ يَدَيَّ وَمِنْ خَلْفِي، وَعَنْ يَمِينِي وَعَنْ شِمَالِي، وَمِنْ فَوْقِي، وَأَعُوذُ بِعَظَمَتِكَ أَنْ أُغْتَالَ مِنْ تَحْتِي.
(أخرجه أبو داود)

items.textEn:
O Allah, I ask You for well-being in this world and the Hereafter.
O Allah, I ask You for pardon and well-being in my religion, my worldly affairs, my family, and my wealth.
O Allah, conceal my faults and calm my fears.
O Allah, protect me from in front of me, from behind me, from my right, from my left, and from above me,
and I seek refuge in Your greatness lest I be swallowed up from beneath me.
items.translit:
Allahumma inni as’aluka al-‘afiyata fid-dunya wal-akhirah,

Allahumma as’aluka al-‘afwa wal-‘afiyata fi dini wa dunyaya wa ahli wa mali,

Allahumma astur ‘awrati wa amin raw‘ati,

Allahumma ihfazni min bayni yadayya wa min khalfi,

Wa ‘an yamini wa ‘an shimali wa min fawqi,

Wa a‘udhu bi ‘azamatika an ughtala min tahti.

segments.t: اللَّهُمَّ أَحْسِنْ عَاقِبَتَنَا فِي الْأُمُورِ كُلِّهَا، وَأَجِرْنَا مِنْ خِزْيِ الدُّنْيَا وَعَذَابِ الْآخِرَةِ.
(رواه أحمد والطبراني في الكبير، وقال الحافظ الهيثمي في مجمع الزوائد: رجال أحمد وأحد أسانيد الطبراني ثقات)

items.textEn: O Allah, make the outcome of all our affairs good, and save us from the disgrace of this world and the torment of the Hereafter.
items.translit:
Allahumma ahsin ‘aqibatana fil-umuri kulliha,

Wa ajirna min khizyi ad-dunya wa ‘adhabi al-akhirah.

segments.t: رَبِّ أَعِنِّي وَلَا تُعِنْ عَلَيَّ، وَانْصُرْنِي وَلَا تَنْصُرْ عَلَيَّ، وَامْكُرْ لِي وَلَا تَمْكُرْ عَلَيَّ، وَاهْدِنِي وَيَسِّرِ الْهُدَى لِي، وَانْصُرْنِي عَلَى مَنْ بَغَى عَلَيَّ، رَبِّ اجْعَلْنِي لَكَ شَكَّارًا، لَكَ ذَكَّارًا، لَكَ رَهَّابًا، لَكَ مُطْوَاعًا، إِلَيْكَ مُخْبِتًا، لَكَ أَوَّاهًا مُنِيبًا، رَبِّ تَقَبَّلْ تَوْبَتِي، وَاغْسِلْ حَوْبَتِي، وَأَجِبْ دَعْوَتِي، وَثَبِّتْ حُجَّتِي، وَاهْدِ قَلْبِي، وَسَدِّدْ لِسَانِي، وَاسْلُلْ سَخِيمَةَ قَلْبِي.
(رواه أبو داود والترمذي وابن ماجه والحاكم وصححه ووافقه الذهبي)

items.textEn:
My Lord, help me and do not help against me; support me and do not support anyone against me; plan for me and do not plan against me.
Guide me and make guidance easy for me; and grant me victory over those who transgress against me.
My Lord, make me ever grateful to You, ever remembering You, ever fearful of You, ever obedient to You, ever humble toward You, ever turning in repentance to You.
My Lord, accept my repentance, cleanse me of my sins, answer my supplication, establish my proof, guide my heart, make my tongue truthful, and remove hatred from my heart.
items.translit:
Rabbi a‘inni wa la tu‘in ‘alayya,

Wansurni wa la tansur ‘alayya,

Wamkur li wa la tamkur ‘alayya,

Wahdini wa yassir al-huda li,

Wansurni ‘ala man bagha ‘alayya,

Rabbi-j‘alni laka shakkaran,

Laka dhakkaran,

Laka rahhaban,

Laka mutwa‘an,

Ilayka mukhbita,

Laka awwahan muniban,

Rabbi taqabbal tawbati,

Waghsil hawbati,

Wa ajib da‘wati,

Wa thabbit hujjati,

Wahdi qalbi,

Wa saddid lisani,

Waslul sakhimata qalbi.

segments.t: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْعَجْزِ وَالْكَسَلِ وَالْجُبْنِ وَالْبُخْلِ وَالْهَرَمِ وَالْقَسْوَةِ وَالْغَفْلَةِ وَالْعَيْلَةِ وَالذِّلَّةِ وَالْمَسْكَنَةِ، وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْفَقْرِ وَالْكُفْرِ وَالْفُسُوقِ وَالشِّقَاقِ وَالنِّفَاقِ وَالسُّمْعَةِ وَالرِّيَاءِ، وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الصَّمَمِ وَالْبُكْمِ وَالْجُنُونِ وَالْجُذَامِ وَالْبَرَصِ وَسَيِّءِ الْأَسْقَامِ.
(أخرجه الطبراني)

items.textEn:
O Allah, I seek refuge in You from incapacity, laziness, cowardice, miserliness, senility, hardness of heart, heedlessness, poverty, humiliation, and misery.
I seek refuge in You from poverty, disbelief, sin, discord, hypocrisy, showing off, and seeking fame.
And I seek refuge in You from deafness, dumbness, madness, leprosy, vitiligo, and evil diseases.
items.translit:
Allahumma inni a‘udhu bika minal-‘ajzi wal-kasal,

Wal-jubni wal-bukhl wal-haram wal-qaswah wal-ghaflah wal-‘aylah wadh-dhillah wal-maskana,

Wa a‘udhu bika minal-faqri wal-kufri wal-fusuqi wash-shiqaqi wan-nifaqi was-sum‘ati war-riya’,

Wa a‘udhu bika minas-samami wal-bukmi wal-jununi wal-judhami wal-barasi wa sayyi’il-asqam.

segments.t: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْجُوعِ، فَإِنَّهُ بِئْسَ الضَّجِيعُ، وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْخِيَانَةِ، فَإِنَّهَا بِئْسَتِ الْبِطَانَةُ.
(رواه أبو داود، والنسائي، وابن ماجه)

items.textEn:
O Allah, I seek refuge in You from hunger, for it is a terrible companion.
And I seek refuge in You from treachery, for it is an evil trait.
items.translit:
Allahumma inni a‘udhu bika minal-jū‘,

Fa’innahu bi’sas-dhajī‘,

Wa a‘udhu bika minal-khiyānah,

Fa’innahā bi’satil-bitānah.

items.title: اللَّهُمَّ إني أسألُك من فضلِك و رحمتِك ؛ فإنَّه لا يملُكها إلا أنت.

segments.t: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ مِنْ فَضْلِكَ وَرَحْمَتِكَ، فَإِنَّهُ لَا يَمْلِكُهَا إِلَّا أَنْتَ.
(أخرجه الطبراني)

items.textEn: O Allah, I ask You for Your bounty and mercy, for none owns them except You.
items.translit:
Allahumma inni as’aluka min fadhlika wa rahmatika,

Fa’innahu la yamlikuha illa ant.

segments.t: اللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لِي ذَنْبِي كُلَّهُ، دِقَّهُ وَجِلَّهُ، وَأَوَّلَهُ وَآخِرَهُ، وَعَلَانِيَتَهُ وَسِرَّهُ.
(رواه مسلم)

items.textEn: O Allah, forgive me all my sins, the small and the great, the first and the last, the open and the hidden.
items.translit:
Allahumma ighfir li dhanbi kullah,

Diqqahu wa jillahu,

Wa awwalahu wa akhirahu,

Wa ‘alaniyatahu wa sirrah.

segments.t: اللَّهُمَّ لَكَ أَسْلَمْتُ، وَبِكَ آمَنْتُ، وَعَلَيْكَ تَوَكَّلْتُ، وَإِلَيْكَ أَنَبْتُ، وَبِكَ خَاصَمْتُ، اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِعِزَّتِكَ، لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ، أَنْ تُضِلَّنِي، أَنْتَ الْحَيُّ الَّذِي لَا يَمُوتُ، وَالْجِنُّ وَالْإِنْسُ يَمُوتُونَ.
(متفق عليه)

items.textEn:
O Allah, to You I have submitted, in You I have believed, upon You I have relied, to You I have turned in repentance, and by You I have argued.
O Allah, I seek refuge in Your might—there is no deity but You—from being led astray.
You are the Ever-Living who does not die, while jinn and humans die.
items.translit:
Allahumma laka aslamtu,

Wa bika amantu,

Wa ‘alayka tawakkaltu,

Wa ilayka anabtu,

Wa bika khasamtu,

Allahumma inni a‘udhu bi ‘izzatika,

La ilaha illa ant,

An tudhillani,

Antal-hayyul-ladhi la yamut,

Wal-jinnu wal-insu yamutun.

segments.t: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي ظَلَمْتُ نَفْسِي ظُلْمًا كَثِيرًا، وَلَا يَغْفِرُ الذُّنُوبَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ، فَاغْفِرْ لِي مَغْفِرَةً مِنْ عِنْدِكَ، وَارْحَمْنِي، إِنَّكَ أَنْتَ الْغَفُورُ الرَّحِيمُ.
(متفق عليه)

items.textEn:
O Allah, I have wronged myself greatly, and none forgives sins except You.
So forgive me with a forgiveness from You, and have mercy on me. Indeed, You are the Most Forgiving, the Most Merciful.
items.translit:
Allahumma inni zalamtu nafsi zulman kathiran,

Wa la yaghfirudh-dhunuba illa ant,

Faghfir li maghfiratan min ‘indika,

Warhamni,

Innaka antal-ghafurur-rahim.

segments.t: اللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لِي خَطِيئَتِي، وَجَهْلِي، وَإِسْرَافِي فِي أَمْرِي، وَمَا أَنْتَ أَعْلَمُ بِهِ مِنِّي، اللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لِي هَزْلِي وَجِدِّي، وَخَطَئِي وَعَمْدِي، وَكُلُّ ذَلِكَ عِنْدِي.
(رواه البخاري مع الفتح)

items.textEn:
O Allah, forgive my mistakes, my ignorance, my excesses in my affairs, and all that You know better than I do.
O Allah, forgive my joking and seriousness, my mistakes and intentional actions, and all of that is within me.
items.translit:
Allahumma ighfir li khati’ati,

Wa jahli,

Wa israfi fi amri,

Wa ma anta a‘lamu bihi minni,

Allahumma ighfir li hazli wa jiddi,

Wa khata’i wa ‘amdi,

Wa kullu dhalika ‘indi.

segments.t: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْبُخْلِ، وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْجُبْنِ، وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ أَنْ أُرَدَّ إِلَى أَرْذَلِ الْعُمُرِ، وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ فِتْنَةِ الدُّنْيَا، وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ عَذَابِ الْقَبْرِ.
(رواه البخاري مع الفتح)

items.textEn: O Allah, I seek refuge in You from miserliness, from cowardice, from being returned to the worst of ages, from the trials of this world, and from the punishment of the grave.
items.translit:
Allahumma inni a‘udhu bika minal-bukhl,

Wa a‘udhu bika minal-jubn,

Wa a‘udhu bika an uradda ila ardhali al-‘umur,

Wa a‘udhu bika min fitnati ad-dunya,

Wa a‘udhu bika min ‘adhabi al-qabr.

segments.t: اللَّهُمَّ اقْسِمْ لَنَا مِنْ خَشْيَتِكَ مَا تَحُولُ بِهِ بَيْنَنَا وَبَيْنَ مَعَاصِيكَ، وَمِنْ طَاعَتِكَ مَا تُبَلِّغُنَا بِهِ جَنَّتَكَ، وَمِنَ الْيَقِينِ مَا تُهَوِّنُ بِهِ عَلَيْنَا مَصَائِبَ الدُّنْيَا، اللَّهُمَّ مَتِّعْنَا بِأَسْمَاعِنَا وَأَبْصَارِنَا وَقُوَّتِنَا مَا أَحْيَيْتَنَا، وَاجْعَلْهُ الْوَارِثَ مِنَّا، وَاجْعَلْ ثَأْرَنَا عَلَى مَنْ ظَلَمَنَا، وَانْصُرْنَا عَلَى مَنْ عَادَانَا، وَلَا تَجْعَلْ مُصِيبَتَنَا فِي دِينِنَا، وَلَا تَجْعَلِ الدُّنْيَا أَكْبَرَ هَمِّنَا، وَلَا مَبْلَغَ عِلْمِنَا، وَلَا تُسَلِّطْ عَلَيْنَا مَنْ لَا يَرْحَمُنَا.
(رواه الترمذي والحاكم وصححه ووافقه الذهبي، وابن السني)

items.textEn:
O Allah, grant us such fear of You as will come between us and disobedience to You, such obedience to You as will bring us to Your Paradise, and such certainty as will make the calamities of this world easy for us.
O Allah, let us enjoy our hearing, our sight, and our strength as long as You keep us alive, and make them our inheritors.
Make our revenge upon those who wrong us, and grant us victory over those who show enmity to us.
Do not make our calamity in our religion, do not make this world our greatest concern or the extent of our knowledge, and do not give power over us to those who will not show us mercy.
items.translit:
Allahumma qsim lana min khashyatika ma tahulu bihi baynana wa bayna ma‘asik,

Wa min ta‘atika ma tuballighuna bihi jannatak,

Wa minal-yaqini ma tuhawwinu bihi ‘alayna masa’ibad-dunya,

Allahumma matti‘na bi asma‘ina wa absarina wa quwwatina ma ahyaitana,

Waj‘alhu al-waritha minna,

Waj‘al tha’rana ‘ala man zalamana,

Wansurna ‘ala man ‘adana,

Wa la taj‘al musibatana fi dinina,

Wa la taj‘alid-dunya akbara hammina,

Wa la mablagha ‘ilmina,

Wa la tusallit ‘alayna man la yarhamuna.

segments.t: اللَّهُمَّ احْفَظْنِي بِالْإِسْلَامِ قَائِمًا، وَاحْفَظْنِي بِالْإِسْلَامِ قَاعِدًا، وَاحْفَظْنِي بِالْإِسْلَامِ رَاقِدًا، وَلَا تُشْمِتْ بِي عَدُوًّا وَلَا حَاسِدًا، اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ مِنْ كُلِّ خَيْرٍ خَزَائِنُهُ بِيَدِكَ، وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ كُلِّ شَرٍّ خَزَائِنُهُ بِيَدِكَ.
(رواه الحاكم وصححه ووافقه الذهبي)

items.textEn:
O Allah, protect me with Islam while standing, protect me with Islam while sitting, and protect me with Islam while lying down.
Do not let any enemy or envious person rejoice over me.
O Allah, I ask You for all good whose treasures are in Your hand, and I seek refuge in You from all evil whose treasures are in Your hand.
items.translit:
Allahumma ihfazni bil-islami qa’iman,

Wahfazni bil-islami qa‘idan,

Wahfazni bil-islami raqidan,

Wa la tushmit bi ‘aduwwan wa la hasidan,

Allahumma inni as’aluka min kulli khayrin khaza’inuhu biyadik,

Wa a‘udhu bika min kulli sharrin khaza’inuhu biyadik.

segments.t:
اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ مِنَ الْخَيْرِ كُلِّهِ، عَاجِلِهِ وَآجِلِهِ، مَا عَلِمْتُ مِنْهُ وَمَا لَمْ أَعْلَمْ،
وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الشَّرِّ كُلِّهِ، عَاجِلِهِ وَآجِلِهِ، مَا عَلِمْتُ مِنْهُ وَمَا لَمْ أَعْلَمْ،
اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ مِنْ خَيْرِ مَا سَأَلَكَ عَبْدُكَ وَنَبِيُّكَ،
وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا عَاذَ بِهِ عَبْدُكَ وَنَبِيُّكَ،
اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ الْجَنَّةَ وَمَا قَرَّبَ إِلَيْهَا مِنْ قَوْلٍ أَوْ عَمَلٍ،
وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ النَّارِ وَمَا قَرَّبَ إِلَيْهَا مِنْ قَوْلٍ أَوْ عَمَلٍ،
وَأَسْأَلُكَ أَنْ تَجْعَلَ كُلَّ قَضَاءٍ قَضَيْتَهُ لِي خَيْرًا.
(رواه ابن ماجه وأحمد والحاكم)

items.textEn:
O Allah, I ask You for all good, the immediate and the delayed, that which I know and that which I do not know.
I seek refuge in You from all evil, the immediate and the delayed, that which I know and that which I do not know.
O Allah, I ask You for the good that Your servant and Prophet asked You for,
and I seek refuge in You from the evil from which Your servant and Prophet sought refuge.
O Allah, I ask You for Paradise and for whatever words or deeds bring me closer to it,
and I seek refuge in You from the Fire and from whatever words or deeds bring me closer to it.
And I ask You to make every decree You decree for me good.
items.translit:
Allahumma inni as’aluka minal-khayri kullihi,

‘Ajilihi wa ajilihi,

Ma ‘alimtu minhu wa ma lam a‘lam,

Wa a‘udhu bika minash-sharri kullihi,

‘Ajilihi wa ajilihi,

Ma ‘alimtu minhu wa ma lam a‘lam,

Allahumma inni as’aluka min khayri ma sa’alaka ‘abduka wa nabiyyuk,

Wa a‘udhu bika min sharri ma ‘adha bihi ‘abduka wa nabiyyuk,

Allahumma inni as’aluka al-jannata wa ma qarraba ilayha min qawlin aw ‘amal,

Wa a‘udhu bika minan-nari wa ma qarraba ilayha min qawlin aw ‘amal,

Wa as’aluka an taj‘ala kulla qada’in qadaytahu li khayra.

segments.t: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ فِعْلَ الْخَيْرَاتِ، وَتَرْكَ الْمُنْكَرَاتِ، وَحُبَّ الْمَسَاكِينِ، وَأَنْ تَغْفِرَ لِي وَتَرْحَمَنِي، وَإِذَا أَرَدْتَ فِتْنَةً فِي قَوْمٍ فَتَوَفَّنِي غَيْرَ مَفْتُونٍ، وَأَسْأَلُكَ حُبَّكَ، وَحُبَّ مَنْ يُحِبُّكَ، وَحُبَّ عَمَلٍ يُقَرِّبُنِي إِلَى حُبِّكَ.
(رواه أحمد بلفظه والترمذي بنحوه والحاكم، وحسنه الترمذي، وقال: سألت محمد بن إسماعيل - يعني البخاري - فقال: هذا حديث حسن صحيح، وفي آخر الحديث قال صلى الله عليه وسلم: "إنها حقٌّ فادرسوها وتعلموها")

items.textEn:
O Allah, I ask You to enable me to do good deeds, to avoid evil deeds, and to love the poor.
Forgive me, have mercy on me, and when You will a trial for a people, take me to You without being tried.
I ask You for Your love, the love of those who love You, and the love of deeds that bring me closer to Your love.
(The Prophet ﷺ said at the end of this hadith: “It is true, so study it and learn it.”)
items.translit:
Allahumma inni as’aluka fi‘lal-khayrat,

Wa tarkal-munkarat,

Wa hubbal-masakin,

Wa an taghfira li wa tarhamani,

Wa idha aradta fitnatan fi qawmin fatawaffani ghayra maftunin,

Wa as’aluka hubbak,

Wa hubba man yuhibbuk,

Wa hubba ‘amalin yuqarribuni ila hubbik.

segments.t: اللَّهُمَّ إِنَّكَ عَفُوٌّ تُحِبُّ الْعَفْوَ فَاعْفُ عَنِّي.
(رواه الترمذي)

items.textEn: O Allah, You are Forgiving and love forgiveness, so forgive me.
items.translit:
Allahumma innaka ‘afuwwun,

Tuhibbul-‘afwa,

Fa‘fu ‘anni.

segments.t: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ مُنْكَرَاتِ الْأَخْلَاقِ وَالْأَعْمَالِ وَالْأَهْوَاءِ.
(الترمذي وابن حبان، والحاكم، والطبراني)

items.textEn: O Allah, I seek refuge in You from evil manners, deeds, and desires.
items.translit:
Allahumma inni a‘udhu bika min munkaratil-akhlaq,

Wal-a‘mal,

Wal-ahwa’.

segments.t: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْبَرَصِ، وَالْجُنُونِ، وَالْجُذَامِ، وَمِنْ سَيِّئِ الْأَسْقَامِ.
(رواه أبو داود والنسائي وأحمد والترمذي)

items.textEn: O Allah, I seek refuge in You from leprosy, madness, mutilation, and from evil diseases.
items.translit:
Allahumma inni a‘udhu bika minal-barasi,

Wal-jununi,

Wal-judhami,

Wa min sayyi’il-asqam.

segments.t: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّ سَمْعِي، وَمِنْ شَرِّ بَصَرِي، وَمِنْ شَرِّ لِسَانِي، وَمِنْ شَرِّ قَلْبِي، وَمِنْ شَرِّ مَنِيِّي.
(رواه أبو داود والترمذي والنسائي)

items.textEn: O Allah, I seek refuge in You from the evil of my hearing, the evil of my sight, the evil of my tongue, the evil of my heart, and the evil of my semen (lust or desires).
items.translit:
Allahumma inni a‘udhu bika min sharri sam‘i,

Wa min sharri basari,

Wa min sharri lisani,

Wa min sharri qalbi,

Wa min sharri maniyyi.

segments.t: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ عِلْمًا نَافِعًا، وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ عِلْمٍ لَا يَنْفَعُ.
(رواه ابن ماجه ولفظه: سلوا الله علمًا نافعًا وتعوذوا بالله من علم لا ينفع)

items.textEn: O Allah, I ask You for beneficial knowledge, and I seek refuge in You from knowledge that does not benefit.
items.translit:
Allahumma inni as’aluka ‘ilman nafi‘an,

Wa a‘udhu bika min ‘ilmin la yanfa‘.

segments.t: اللَّهُمَّ أَلْهِمْنِي رُشْدِي، وَاعِذْنِي مِنْ شَرِّ نَفْسِي.
(رواه أحمد والترمذي واللفظ له)

items.textEn: O Allah, inspire me with guidance and protect me from the evil of my own self.
items.translit:
Allahumma alhimni rushdi,

Wa ‘idhni min sharri nafsi.

segments.t: اللَّهُمَّ رَبَّ جِبْرَائِيلَ وَمِيكَائِيلَ وَرَبَّ إِسْرَافِيلَ، أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ حَرِّ النَّارِ، وَمِنْ عَذَابِ الْقَبْرِ.
(رواه النسائي)

items.textEn: O Allah, Lord of Jibreel, Mikaeel, and Israfeel, I seek refuge in You from the heat of the Fire and from the punishment of the grave.
items.translit:
Allahumma rabba Jibra’il,

Wa Mika’il,

Wa rabba Israfil,

A‘udhu bika min harri an-nar,

Wa min ‘adhabil-qabr.

segments.t: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْبُخْلِ، وَالْجُبْنِ، وَسُوءِ الْعُمُرِ، وَفِتْنَةِ الصَّدْرِ، وَعَذَابِ الْقَبْرِ.
(رواه النسائي)

items.textEn: O Allah, I seek refuge in You from miserliness, cowardice, an evil end to life, the trials of the heart, and the punishment of the grave.
items.translit:
Allahumma inni a‘udhu bika minal-bukhl,

Wal-jubn,

Wa su’il-‘umur,

Wa fitnat-is-sadr,

Wa ‘adhabil-qabr.

segments.t: اللَّهُمَّ طَهِّرْنِي مِنَ الذُّنُوبِ وَالْخَطَايَا، اللَّهُمَّ نَقِّنِي مِنْهَا كَمَا يُنَقَّى الثَّوْبُ الْأَبْيَضُ مِنَ الدَّنَسِ، اللَّهُمَّ طَهِّرْنِي بِالثَّلْجِ وَالْبَرَدِ وَالْمَاءِ الْبَارِدِ.
(رواه النسائي، والترمذي)

items.textEn:
O Allah, cleanse me of sins and wrongdoings.
O Allah, purify me from them as a white garment is cleansed from dirt.
O Allah, wash me with snow, hail, and cold water.
items.translit:
Allahumma tahhirni min adh-dhunubi wal-khataya,

Allahumma naqqini minha kama yunaqqa ath-thawbul-abyadu minad-danas,

Allahumma tahhirni bith-thalji wal-baradi wal-ma’il-barid.

segments.t: اللَّهُمَّ ارْزُقْنِي حُبَّكَ، وَحُبَّ مَنْ يَنْفَعُنِي حُبُّهُ عِنْدَكَ، اللَّهُمَّ مَا رَزَقْتَنِي مِمَّا أُحِبُّ فَاجْعَلْهُ قُوَّةً لِي فِيمَا تُحِبُّ، اللَّهُمَّ مَا زَوَيْتَ عَنِّي مِمَّا أُحِبُّ فَاجْعَلْهُ فَرَاغًا لِي فِيمَا تُحِبُّ.
(رواه الترمذي)

items.textEn:
O Allah, grant me Your love and the love of those whose love benefits me with You.
O Allah, whatever You have provided me of what I love, make it strength for me in what You love.
And whatever You have withheld from me of what I love, make it free time for me in what You love.
items.translit:
Allahumma arzuqni hubbak,

Wa hubba man yanfa‘uni hubbuhu ‘indak,

Allahumma ma razaqtani mimma uhibbu faj‘alhu quwwatan li fima tuhibb,

Allahumma ma zawayta ‘anni mimma uhibbu faj‘alhu faraghan li fima tuhibb.

segments.t:
اللَّهُمَّ بِعِلْمِكَ الْغَيْبَ، وَقُدْرَتِكَ عَلَى الْخَلْقِ، أَحْيِنِي مَا عَلِمْتَ الْحَيَاةَ خَيْرًا لِي، وَتَوَفَّنِي إِذَا عَلِمْتَ الْوَفَاةَ خَيْرًا لِي، اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ خَشْيَتَكَ فِي الْغَيْبِ وَالشَّهَادَةِ، وَأَسْأَلُكَ كَلِمَةَ الْحَقِّ فِي الرِّضَا وَالْغَضَبِ، وَأَسْأَلُكَ الْقَصْدَ فِي الْغِنَى وَالْفَقْرِ، وَأَسْأَلُكَ نَعِيمًا لَا يَنْفَدُ، وَأَسْأَلُكَ قُرَّةَ عَيْنٍ لَا تَنْقَطِعُ، وَأَسْأَلُكَ الرِّضَا بَعْدَ الْقَضَاءِ،
وَأَسْأَلُكَ بَرْدَ الْعَيْشِ بَعْدَ الْمَوْتِ، وَأَسْأَلُكَ لَذَّةَ النَّظَرِ إِلَى وَجْهِكَ، وَالشَّوْقَ إِلَى لِقَائِكَ، فِي غَيْرِ ضَرَّاءَ مُضِرَّةٍ، وَلَا فِتْنَةٍ مُضِلَّةٍ،
اللَّهُمَّ زَيِّنَّا بِزِينَةِ الْإِيمَانِ، وَاجْعَلْنَا هُدَاةً مُهْتَدِينَ.
(رواه النسائي وأحمد وإسناده جيد)

items.textEn:
O Allah, by Your knowledge of the unseen and by Your power over creation, keep me alive as long as life is good for me, and cause me to die when death is better for me.
O Allah, I ask You for fear of You in private and in public, and I ask You for a word of truth in times of contentment and anger.
I ask You for moderation in wealth and poverty, for a bliss that never ends, and for the comfort of my eyes that never ceases.
I ask You for satisfaction after destiny, and for a cool and peaceful life after death.
I ask You for the joy of looking upon Your noble Face and the longing to meet You, without any harmful hardship or misleading trial.
O Allah, adorn us with the beauty of faith, and make us guides who are rightly guided.
items.translit:
Allahumma bi ‘ilmikal-ghaybi wa qudratika ‘ala al-khalq,

Ahyini ma ‘alimtal-hayata khayran li,

Wa tawaffani idha ‘alimtal-wafata khayran li,

Allahumma inni as’aluka khashyataka fil-ghaybi wash-shahadah,

Wa as’aluka kalimat al-haqqi fir-rida wal-ghadab,

Wa as’aluka al-qasda fil-ghina wal-faqr,

Wa as’aluka na‘iman la yanfad,

Wa as’aluka qurrata ‘aynin la tanqati‘,

Wa as’aluka ridha ba‘dal-qada’,

Wa as’aluka barda al-‘ayshi ba‘dal-mawt,

Wa as’aluka ladhdhatan-nazari ila wajhik,

Wash-shawqa ila liqa’ika,

Fi ghayri darra’a mudirrah,

Wa la fitnatin mudillah,

Allahumma zayyinna bi zinatil-iman,

Waj‘alna hudatan muhtadin.

segments.t: رَبِّ اغْفِرْ لِي وَتُبْ عَلَيَّ، إِنَّكَ أَنْتَ التَّوَّابُ الْغَفُورُ.
(رواه أبو داود، والترمذي واللفظ له، والنسائي، وابن ماجه)

items.textEn: My Lord, forgive me and accept my repentance. Indeed, You are the Ever-Accepting of repentance, the Most Forgiving.
items.translit:
Rabbi ighfir li wa tub ‘alayya,

Innaka anta at-tawwabu al-ghafur.

segments.t: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ بِأَنِّي أَشْهَدُ أَنَّكَ أَنْتَ اللَّهُ، لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ، الْأَحَدُ، الصَّمَدُ، الَّذِي لَمْ يَلِدْ، وَلَمْ يُولَدْ، وَلَمْ يَكُنْ لَهُ كُفُوًا أَحَدٌ.
(رواه أبو داود والترمذي وابن ماجه وأحمد)

items.textEn: O Allah, I ask You because I bear witness that You are Allah — there is no deity but You — the One, the Eternal Refuge, who begets not, nor is born, and there is none comparable to Him.
items.translit:
Allahumma inni as’aluka bi anni ashhadu annaka anta Allah,

La ilaha illa ant,

Al-ahad as-samad,

Alladhi lam yalid wa lam yulad,

Wa lam yakun lahu kufuwan ahad.

segments.t: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ بِأَنَّ لَكَ الْحَمْدَ، لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ، وَحْدَكَ لَا شَرِيكَ لَكَ، الْمَنَّانُ، بَدِيعَ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ، يَا ذَا الْجَلَالِ وَالْإِكْرَامِ، يَا حَيُّ يَا قَيُّومُ، إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ الْجَنَّةَ، وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ النَّارِ.
(رواه أبو داود وابن ماجه والنسائي والترمذي)

items.textEn: O Allah, I ask You as all praise belongs to You. There is no deity but You, You have no partner. You are the Bestower, the Originator of the heavens and the earth, O Possessor of Majesty and Honor, O Ever-Living, O Sustainer. I ask You for Paradise and seek refuge in You from the Fire.
items.translit:
Allahumma inni as’aluka bi anna laka al-hamd,

La ilaha illa ant wahdaka la sharika lak,

Al-mannan,

Badi‘as-samawati wal-ardh,

Ya dhal-jalali wal-ikram,

Ya hayyu ya qayyum,

Inni as’aluka al-jannah,

Wa a‘udhu bika minan-nar.

segments.t: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ يَا اللَّهُ بِأَنَّكَ الْوَاحِدُ الْأَحَدُ، الصَّمَدُ، الَّذِي لَمْ يَلِدْ وَلَمْ يُولَدْ، وَلَمْ يَكُنْ لَهُ كُفُوًا أَحَدٌ، أَنْ تَغْفِرَ لِي ذُنُوبِي، إِنَّكَ أَنْتَ الْغَفُورُ الرَّحِيمُ.
(رواه النسائي بلفظه وأحمد)

items.textEn: O Allah, I ask You, O Allah, by the fact that You are the One, the Only, the Eternal Refuge, who begets not, nor is born, and there is none comparable to You, to forgive my sins. Indeed, You are the Most Forgiving, the Most Merciful.
items.translit:
Allahumma inni as’aluka ya Allahu bi annaka al-wahidul-ahad,

As-samad,

Alladhi lam yalid wa lam yulad,

Wa lam yakun lahu kufuwan ahad,

An taghfira li dhunubi,

Innaka antal-ghafurur-rahim.

segments.t: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ عِلْمًا نَافِعًا، وَرِزْقًا طَيِّبًا، وَعَمَلًا مُتَقَبَّلًا.
(رواه ابن ماجه)

items.textEn: O Allah, I ask You for beneficial knowledge, good and lawful provision, and accepted deeds.
items.translit:
Allahumma inni as’aluka ‘ilman nafi‘an,

Wa rizqan tayyiban,

Wa ‘amalan mutaqabbalan.

segments.t: اللَّهُمَّ انْفَعْنِي بِمَا عَلَّمْتَنِي، وَعَلِّمْنِي مَا يَنْفَعُنِي، وَزِدْنِي عِلْمًا.
(رواه ابن ماجه)

items.textEn: O Allah, benefit me with what You have taught me, teach me what will benefit me, and increase me in knowledge.
items.translit:
Allahumma anfa‘ni bima ‘allamtani,

Wa ‘allimni ma yanfa‘uni,

Wa zidni ‘ilma.

segments.t: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ أَنْ أُشْرِكَ بِكَ وَأَنَا أَعْلَمُ، وَاسْتَغْفِرُكَ لِمَا لَا أَعْلَمُ.
(رواه أحمد وغيره، وانظر صحيح الترغيب والترهيب للألباني)

items.textEn: O Allah, I seek refuge in You from associating anything with You knowingly, and I seek Your forgiveness for what I do unknowingly.
items.translit:
Allahumma inni a‘udhu bika an ushrika bika wa ana a‘lam,

Wa astaghfiruka lima la a‘lam.

segments.t: اللَّهُمَّ فَقِّهْنِي فِي الدِّينِ.
(يَدُلُّ عَلَيْهِ رِوَايَةُ الْبُخَارِيِّ وَمُسْلِمٍ فِي دُعَاءِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ لِابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُمَا)

items.textEn: O Allah, grant me understanding in religion.
items.translit: Allahumma faqqihni fid-din.

segments.t: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ الْجَنَّةَ، وَأَسْتَجِيرُ بِكَ مِنَ النَّارِ.
(ثلاث مرات). (رواه الترمذي وابن ماجه والنسائي، ولفظه: من سأل الله الجنة ثلاث مرات قالت الجنة: اللَّهُمَّ أَدْخِلْهُ الجنة، ومن استجار من النار ثلاث مرات قالت النار: اللَّهُمَّ أَجِرْهُ من النار)

items.textEn: O Allah, I ask You for Paradise, and I seek refuge in You from the Fire.
items.translit:
Allahumma inni as’aluka al-jannah,

Wa astajiru bika minan-nar.

segments.t: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ يَوْمِ السُّوءِ، وَمِنْ لَيْلَةِ السُّوءِ، وَمِنْ سَاعَةِ السُّوءِ، وَمِنْ صَاحِبِ السُّوءِ، وَمِنْ جَارِ السُّوءِ فِي دَارِ الْمُقَامَةِ.
(أخرجه الطبراني)

items.textEn: O Allah, I seek refuge in You from an evil day, an evil night, an evil hour, an evil companion, and an evil neighbor in the permanent dwelling.
items.translit:
Allahumma inni a‘udhu bika min yawmis-suu’,

Wa min laylat-is-suu’,

Wa min sa‘at-is-suu’,

Wa min sahib-is-suu’,

Wa min jar-is-suu’ fi dari al-muqamah.

segments.t: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ قَلْبٍ لَا يَخْشَعُ، وَمِنْ دُعَاءٍ لَا يُسْمَعُ، وَمِنْ نَفْسٍ لَا تَشْبَعُ، وَمِنْ عِلْمٍ لَا يَنْفَعُ، أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ هَؤُلَاءِ الْأَرْبَعِ.
(رواه الترمذي وأبو داود)

items.textEn: O Allah, I seek refuge in You from a heart that does not humble, from a supplication that is not heard, from a soul that is never satisfied, and from knowledge that does not benefit. I seek refuge in You from these four things.
items.translit:
Allahumma inni a‘udhu bika min qalbin la yakhsha‘,

Wa min du‘a’in la yusma‘,

Wa min nafsin la tashba‘,

Wa min ‘ilmin la yanfa‘,

A‘udhu bika min ha’ula’il-arba‘.

segments.t: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ جَارِ السُّوءِ فِي دَارِ الْمُقَامَةِ، فَإِنَّ جَارَ الْبَادِيَةِ يَتَحَوَّلُ.
(رواه الحاكم وصححه ووافقه الذهبي)

items.textEn: O Allah, I seek refuge in You from an evil neighbor in the permanent dwelling, for the neighbor in the desert moves away.
items.translit:
Allahumma inni a‘udhu bika min jari as-suu’i fi dari al-muqamah,

Fa’inna jara al-badiyati yatahawwal.

segments.t: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْفَقْرِ، وَالْقِلَّةِ، وَالذِّلَّةِ، وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ أَنْ أَظْلِمَ أَوْ أُظْلَمَ.
(رواه النسائي وأبو داود)

items.textEn: O Allah, I seek refuge in You from poverty, from being few in number, from humiliation, and I seek refuge in You from wronging others or being wronged.
items.translit:
Allahumma inni a‘udhu bika minal-faqr,

Wal-qillah,

Wadh-dhillah,

Wa a‘udhu bika an azlima aw uzlam.

segments.t: اللَّهُمَّ مَتِّعْنِي بِسَمْعِي، وَبَصَرِي، وَاجْعَلْهُمَا الْوَارِثَ مِنِّي، وَانْصُرْنِي عَلَى مَنْ يَظْلِمُنِي، وَخُذْ مِنْهُ بِثَأْرِي.
(رواه الترمذي والحاكم وصححه ووافقه)

items.textEn: O Allah, grant me enjoyment of my hearing and my sight, and make them the inheritors of me. Grant me victory over those who wrong me and take retribution from them on my behalf.
items.translit:
Allahumma matti‘ni bisam‘i wa basari,

Waj‘alhuma al-waritha minni,

Wansurni ‘ala man yadhlimuni,

Wakhudh minhu bith’ari.

segments.t: اللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لِي، وَاهْدِنِي، وَارْزُقْنِي، وَعَافِنِي، أَعُوذُ بِاللَّهِ مِنْ ضِيقِ الْمَقَامِ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ.
(رواه النسائي وابن ماجه)

items.textEn: O Allah, forgive me, guide me, provide for me, and grant me well-being. I seek refuge in Allah from the distress of the standing on the Day of Resurrection.
items.translit:
Allahumma ighfir li,

Wahdini,

Warzuqni,

Wa ‘afini,

A‘udhu billahi min dīqil-maqami yawmal-qiyamah.

segments.t: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ غَلَبَةِ الدَّيْنِ، وَغَلَبَةِ الْعَدُوِّ، وَشَمَاتَةِ الْأَعْدَاءِ.
(رواه النسائي)

items.textEn: O Allah, I seek refuge in You from being overwhelmed by debt, from being overpowered by enemies, and from the gloating of adversaries.
items.translit:
Allahumma inni a‘udhu bika min ghalabatid-dayn,

Wa ghalabatil-‘aduww,

Wa shamātatil-a‘da’.

segments.t: اللَّهُمَّ قِنِي شَرَّ نَفْسِي، وَاعْزِمْ لِي عَلَى أَرْشَدِ أَمْرِي، اللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لِي مَا أَسْرَرْتُ، وَمَا أَعْلَنْتُ، وَمَا أَخْطَأْتُ، وَمَا عَمَدْتُ، وَمَا عَلِمْتُ، وَمَا جَهِلْتُ.
(رواه الحاكم وصححه ووافقه الذهبي، وأخرجه أحمد وقال الحافظ: إسناده صحيح)

items.textEn:
O Allah, protect me from the evil of my own soul and guide me to the most upright course in all my affairs.
O Allah, forgive me for what I have done in secret and in public, for my mistakes and intentional actions, for what I know and for what I am ignorant of.
items.translit:
Allahumma qini sharra nafsi,

Wa a‘zim li ‘ala arshadi amri,

Allahumma ighfir li ma asrartu,

Wa ma a‘lantu,

Wa ma akhta’tu,

Wa ma ‘amattu,

Wa ma ‘alimtu,

Wa ma jahiltu.

segments.t: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ إِيمَانًا لَا يَرْتَدُّ، وَنَعِيمًا لَا يَنْفَدُ، وَمُرَافَقَةَ مُحَمَّدٍ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ فِي أَعْلَى جَنَّةِ الْخُلْدِ.
(رواه ابن حبان، ورواه أحمد عن طريق، والنسائي في عمل اليوم والليلة)

items.textEn: O Allah, I ask You for faith that does not fade, blessings that never end, and the companionship of Muhammad ﷺ in the highest eternal Paradise.
items.translit:
Allahumma inni as’aluka imanan la yartaddu,

Wa na‘iman la yanfaddu,

Wa murafaqata Muhammadin sallallahu ‘alayhi wa sallam,

Fi a‘la jannatil-khuld.

segments.t: اللَّهُمَّ أَعِنَّا عَلَى ذِكْرِكَ، وَشُكْرِكَ، وَحُسْنِ عِبَادَتِكَ.
(رواه الحاكم وصححه ووافقه الذهبي، وهو كما قالا، وهو عند أبي داود والنسائي أن النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم أوصى معاذًا أن يقولها في دبر كل صلاة)

items.textEn: O Allah, help us to remember You, to thank You, and to worship You in the best manner.
items.translit:
Allahumma a‘inna ‘ala dhikrika,

Wa shukrika,

Wa husni ‘ibadatik.

segments.t: اللَّهُمَّ حَاسِبْنِي حِسَابًا يَسِيرًا.

(رواه أحمد والحاكم وقال: صحيح على شرط مسلم، ووافقه الذهبي. قالت عائشة رضي الله عنها: فلما انصرف قلت يا نبي الله ما الحساب اليسير؟ قال: أن ينظر في كتابه فيتجاوز عنه، إنه من نوقش الحساب يومئذ يا عائشة هلك، وكل ما يصيب المؤمن يكفر الله عز وجل به عنه حتى الشوكة تُشاكه)

items.textEn: O Allah, make my reckoning an easy reckoning.
items.translit: Allahumma hasibni hisaban yasira.

segments.t: اللَّهُمَّ قَنِّعْنِي بِمَا رَزَقْتَنِي، وَبَارِكْ لِي فِيهِ، وَاخْلُفْ عَلَيَّ كُلَّ غَائِبَةٍ لِي بِخَيْرٍ.
(رواه الحاكم وصححه ووافقه الذهبي)

items.textEn: O Allah, make me content with what You have provided for me, bless it for me, and replace for me everything I have lost with something better.
items.translit:
Allahumma qanni‘ni bima razaqtani,

Wa barik li fihi,

Wakhluf ‘alayya kulla gha’ibatin li bikhayr.

segments.t: اللَّهُمَّ جَنِّبْنِي مُنْكَرَاتِ الْأَخْلَاقِ، وَالْأَهْوَاءِ، وَالْأَعْمَالِ، وَالْأَدْوَاءِ.
(رواه الحاكم وقال: صحيح على شرط مسلم، ووافقه الذهبي)

items.textEn: O Allah, keep me away from evil manners, desires, deeds, and diseases.
items.translit:
Allahumma jannibni munkaratal-akhlaq,

Wal-ahwa’,

Wal-a‘mal,

Wal-adwa’.

items.title: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ خَيْرَ الْمَسْأَلَةِ،وَخَيْرَ الدُّعَاءِ، وَخَيْرَ النَّجَاحِ، وَخَيْرَ الْعَمَلِ، وَخَيْرَ الثَّوَابِ، وَخَيْرَ الْحَيَاةِ، وَخَيْرَ الْمَمَاتِ، وَثَبِّتْنِي، وَثَقِّل مَوَازِينِي، وَحَقِّقْ إِيمَانِي، وَارْفَعْ دَرَجَاتِي، وَتَقَبَّلْ صَلاَتِي

segments.t: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ خَيْرَ الْمَسْأَلَةِ، وَخَيْرَ الدُّعَاءِ، وَخَيْرَ النَّجَاحِ، وَخَيْرَ الْعَمَلِ، وَخَيْرَ الثَّوَابِ، وَخَيْرَ الْحَيَاةِ، وَخَيْرَ الْمَمَاتِ، وَثَبِّتْنِي، وَثَقِّلْ مَوَازِينِي، وَحَقِّقْ إِيمَانِي، وَارْفَعْ دَرَجَاتِي، وَتَقَبَّلْ صَلاَتِي، وَاغْفِرْ خَطِيئَتِي، وَأَسْأَلُكَ الدَّرَجَاتِ الْعُلَا مِنَ الْجَنَّةِ، اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ فَوَاتِحَ الْخَيْرِ، وَخَوَاتِمَهُ، وَجَوَامِعَهُ، وَأَوَّلَهُ، وَظَاهِرَهُ، وَبَاطِنَهُ، وَالدَّرَجَاتِ الْعُلَا مِنَ الْجَنَّةِ، آمِينْ، اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ خَيْرَ مَا آتِي، وَخَيْرَ مَا أَفْعَلُ، وَخَيْرَ مَا أَعْمَلُ، وَخَيْرَ مَا بَطَنَ، وَخَيْرَ مَا ظَهَرَ، وَالدَّرَجَاتِ الْعُلَا مِنَ الْجَنَّةِ، آمِينْ، اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ أَنْ تَرْفَعَ ذِكْرِي، وَتَضَعَ وِزْرِي، وَتُصْلِحَ أَمْرِي، وَتُطَهِّرَ قَلْبِي، وَتُحَصِّنَ فَرْجِي، وَتُنَوِّرَ قَلْبِي، وَتَغْفِرَ لِي ذَنْبِي، وَأَسْأَلُكَ الدَّرَجَاتِ الْعُلَا مِنَ الْجَنَّةِ، آمِينْ، اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ أَنْ تُبَارِكَ فِي نَفْسِي، وَفِي سَمْعِي، وَفِي بَصَرِي، وَفِي رُوحِي، وَفِي خَلْقِي، وَفِي خُلُقِي، وَفِي أَهْلِي، وَفِي مَحْيَايَ، وَفِي مَمَاتِي، وَفِي عَمَلِي، فَتَقَبَّلْ حَسَنَاتِي، وَأَسْأَلُكَ الدَّرَجَاتِ الْعُلَا مِنَ الْجَنَّةِ، آمِينْ.
(رواه الحاكم عن أم سلمة مرفوعًا وصححه ووافقه الذهبي)

items.textEn:
O Allah, I ask You for the best in asking, the best in supplication, the best in success, the best in deeds, the best in rewards, the best in life, and the best in death.
Make me firm, make my scale heavy, perfect my faith, raise my rank, accept my prayer, forgive my sins, and grant me the highest ranks of Paradise.
O Allah, I ask You for the beginnings of good, its endings, its completeness, its apparent and hidden aspects, and the highest ranks of Paradise — Ameen.
O Allah, I ask You for the best in what I give, the best in what I do, the best in my actions, the best of what is hidden, and the best of what is apparent, and the highest ranks of Paradise — Ameen.
O Allah, I ask You to raise my mention, lighten my burden, set right my affairs, purify my heart, guard my chastity, enlighten my heart, forgive my sins, and grant me the highest ranks of Paradise — Ameen.
O Allah, bless me in myself, my hearing, my sight, my soul, my creation, my character, my family, my life, my death, and my deeds. Accept my good deeds, and grant me the highest ranks of Paradise — Ameen.
items.translit:
Allahumma inni as’aluka khayral-mas’alah,

Wa khayrad-du‘a’,

Wa khayran-najah,

Wa khayral-‘amal,

Wa khayrath-thawab,

Wa khayral-hayah,

Wa khayral-mamat,

Wa thabbitni,

Wa thaqqil mawazini,

Wa haqqiq imani,

Warfa‘ darajati,

Wa taqabbal salati,

Waghfir khati’ati,

Wa as’aluka ad-darajatil-‘ula minal-jannah,

Allahumma inni as’aluka fawatihal-khayr,

Wa khawatimahu,

Wa jawami‘ahu,

Wa awwalahu,

Wa zahirahu,

Wa batinahu,

Wa ad-darajatil-‘ula minal-jannah, ameen,

Allahumma inni as’aluka khayra ma atī,

Wa khayra ma af‘al,

Wa khayra ma a‘mal,

Wa khayra ma batana,

Wa khayra ma zahara,

Wa ad-darajatil-‘ula minal-jannah, ameen,

Allahumma inni as’aluka an tarfa‘a dhikri,

Wa tada‘a wizri,

Wa tusliha amri,

Wa tutahhira qalbi,

Wa tuhassina farji,

Wa tunawwira qalbi,

Wa taghfira li dhanbi,

Wa as’aluka ad-darajatil-‘ula minal-jannah, ameen,

Allahumma inni as’aluka an tubarika fi nafsi,

Wa fi sam‘i,

Wa fi basari,

Wa fi ruhi,

Wa fi khalqi,

Wa fi khuluqi,

Wa fi ahli,

Wa fi mahyaya,

Wa fi mamati,

Wa fi ‘amali,

Fataqabbal hasanati,

Wa as’aluka ad-darajatil-‘ula minal-jannah, ameen.

segments.t: اللَّهُمَّ أَلِّفْ بَيْنَ قُلُوبِنَا، وَأَصْلِحْ ذَاتَ بَيْنِنَا، وَاهْدِنَا سُبُلَ السَّلَامِ، وَنَجِّنَا مِنَ الظُّلُمَاتِ إِلَى النُّورِ، وَجَنِّبْنَا الْفَوَاحِشَ مَا ظَهَرَ مِنْهَا وَمَا بَطَنَ، وَبَارِكْ لَنَا فِي أَسْمَاعِنَا، وَأَبْصَارِنَا، وَقُلُوبِنَا، وَأَزْوَاجِنَا، وَذُرِّيَّاتِنَا، وَتُبْ عَلَيْنَا إِنَّكَ أَنْتَ التَّوَّابُ الرَّحِيمُ، وَاجْعَلْنَا شَاكِرِينَ لِنِعْمِكَ، مُثْنِينَ بِهَا عَلَيْكَ، قَابِلِينَ لَهَا، وَأَتِمِمْهَا عَلَيْنَا.
(رواه الحاكم وقال: صحيح على شرط مسلم، ووافقه الذهبي)

items.textEn:
O Allah, unite our hearts, reconcile our differences, guide us to the paths of peace, deliver us from darkness into light, and keep us away from immoral acts—those apparent and those hidden.
Bless our hearing, our sight, our hearts, our spouses, and our offspring.
Accept our repentance, for You are the Ever-Accepting, the Most Merciful.
Make us grateful for Your blessings, praising You for them, accepting them, and complete Your blessings upon us.
items.translit:
Allahumma allif bayna qulubina,

Wa aslih dhata baynina,

Wahdina subulas-salam,

Wa najjina minadh-dhulumati ilan-nur,

Wajannibna al-fawahisha ma zahara minha wa ma batan,

Wa barik lana fi asma‘ina,

Wa absarina,

Wa qulubina,

Wa azwajina,

Wa dhurriyyatina,

Wa tub ‘alayna innaka anta at-tawwabu ar-rahim,

Waj‘alna shakirin li ni‘mik,

Muthnina biha ‘alayk,

Qabilina laha,

Wa atimmha ‘alayna.

items.title: اللَّهُمَّ رَبَّ السَّمَوَاتِ السَّبْعِ وَرَبَّ الْأَرْضِ، وَرَبَّ الْعَرْشِ الْعَظِيمِ، رَبَّنَا وَرَبَّ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ، فَالِقَ الْحَبِّ وَالنَّوَى، وَمُنْزِلَ التَّوْرَاةِ وَالْإِنْجِيلِ وَالْفُرْقَانِ، أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ أَنْتَ آخِذٌ بِنَاصِيَتِهِ

segments.t: اللَّهُمَّ رَبَّ السَّمَاوَاتِ السَّبْعِ وَرَبَّ الْأَرْضِ، وَرَبَّ الْعَرْشِ الْعَظِيمِ، رَبَّنَا وَرَبَّ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ، فَالِقَ الْحَبِّ وَالنَّوَى، وَمُنْزِلَ التَّوْرَاةِ وَالْإِنْجِيلِ وَالْفُرْقَانِ، أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ أَنْتَ آخِذٌ بِنَاصِيَتِهِ، اللَّهُمَّ أَنْتَ الْأَوَّلُ فَلَيْسَ قَبْلَكَ شَيْءٌ، وَأَنْتَ الْآخِرُ فَلَيْسَ بَعْدَكَ شَيْءٌ، وَأَنْتَ الظَّاهِرُ فَلَيْسَ فَوْقَكَ شَيْءٌ، وَأَنْتَ الْبَاطِنُ فَلَيْسَ دُونَكَ شَيْءٌ، اقْضِ عَنَّا الدَّيْنَ وَأَغْنِنَا مِنَ الْفَقْرِ.
(رواه مسلم)

items.textEn:
O Allah, Lord of the seven heavens and the Lord of the earth, Lord of the Mighty Throne, our Lord and the Lord of all things,
Splitter of the seed and the pit, Revealer of the Torah, the Gospel, and the Qur’an,
I seek refuge in You from the evil of everything You hold by its forelock.
O Allah, You are the First, there is nothing before You; You are the Last, there is nothing after You;
You are the Most High, there is nothing above You; and You are the Most Near, there is nothing closer than You.
Settle our debts for us and enrich us out of poverty.
items.translit:
Allahumma rabbas-samawatis-sab‘,

Wa rabbal-ardh,

Wa rabbal-‘arshil-‘azim,

Rabbana wa rabba kulli shay’,

Faliqal-habbi wan-nawa,

Wa munzilat-tawrati wal-injili wal-furqan,

A‘udhu bika min sharri kulli shay’in anta akhidhun binasiyatih,

Allahumma antal-awwalu fa laysa qablaka shay’,

Wa antal-akhiru fa laysa ba‘daka shay’,

Wa antaz-zahiru fa laysa fawqaka shay’,

Wa antal-batinu fa laysa dunaka shay’,

Iqdi ‘anna ad-dayna wa aghnina minal-faqr.

segments.t: اللَّهُمَّ أَنْتَ رَبِّي، وَأَنَا عَبْدُكَ، لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ، خَلَقْتَنِي وَأَنَا عَبْدُكَ، أَصْبَحْتُ عَلَى عَهْدِكَ وَوَعْدِكَ مَا اسْتَطَعْتُ، أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا صَنَعْتُ، وَأَبُوءُ لَكَ بِنِعْمَتِكَ عَلَيَّ، وَأَبُوءُ لَكَ بِذُنُوبِي، فَاغْفِرْ لِي، إِنَّهُ لَا يَغْفِرُ الذُّنُوبَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ.
(رواه البخاري)

items.textEn:
O Allah, You are my Lord, there is no deity except You. You created me, and I am Your servant.
I uphold Your covenant and promise as best I can. I seek refuge in You from the evil of what I have done.
I acknowledge Your favor upon me, and I confess my sins to You, so forgive me, for none forgives sins except You.
items.translit:
Allahumma anta rabbi,

Wa ana ‘abduka,

La ilaha illa ant,

Khalaqtani wa ana ‘abduka,

Asbahtu ‘ala ‘ahdika wa wa‘dika ma istata‘t,

A‘udhu bika min sharri ma sana‘t,

Wa abū’u laka bini‘matika ‘alayya,

Wa abū’u laka bidhunubi,

Faghfir li,

Innahu la yaghfirudh-dhunuba illa ant.

segments.t: اللَّهُمَّ اجْعَلْ فِي قَلْبِي نُورًا، وَفِي سَمْعِي نُورًا، وَفِي بَصَرِي نُورًا، وَعَنْ يَمِينِي نُورًا، وَعَنْ شِمَالِي نُورًا، وَأَمَامِي نُورًا، وَخَلْفِي نُورًا، وَفَوْقِي نُورًا، وَتَحْتِي نُورًا، وَاجْعَلْ لِي نُورًا،
(وزاد بعضهم):
وَفِي لِسَانِي نُورًا.
(متفق عليه)

items.textEn: O Allah, place light in my heart, light in my hearing, light in my sight, light on my right, light on my left, light before me, light behind me, light above me, and light beneath me, and make for me light.
items.translit:
Allahumma aj‘al fi qalbi nura,

Wa fi sam‘i nura,

Wa fi basari nura,

Wa ‘an yamini nura,

Wa ‘an shimali nura,

Wa amami nura,

Wa khalfi nura,

Wa fawqi nura,

Wa tahti nura,

Wa aj‘al li nura,

Wa fi lisani nura.

segments.t: يَا حَيُّ يَا قَيُّومُ بِرَحْمَتِكَ أَسْتَغِيثُ.
(رواه الترمذي)

items.textEn: O Ever-Living, O Sustainer, by Your mercy I seek help.
items.translit:
Ya hayyu ya qayyum,

Birahmatika astaghith.

segments.t: اللَّهُمَّ قِنِي عَذَابَكَ يَوْمَ تَبْعَثُ عِبَادَكَ.
(رواه الترمذي وقال حديث حسن)

items.textEn: O Allah, protect me from Your punishment on the Day You resurrect Your servants.
items.translit: Allahumma qini ‘adhabaka yawma tab‘athu ‘ibadak.

items.title: اللَّهُمَّ لكَ الحَمْدُ أنْتَ قَيِّمُ السَّمَوَاتِ والأرْضِ

segments.t: عن ابن عباس قال: كان النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم إذا قام من الليل يتهجد قال:

اللَّهُمَّ لكَ الحَمْدُ أنْتَ قَيِّمُ السَّمَوَاتِ والأرْضِ ومَن فِيهِنَّ، ولَكَ الحَمْدُ لكَ مُلْكُ السَّمَوَاتِ والأرْضِ ومَن فِيهِنَّ، ولَكَ الحَمْدُ أنْتَ نُورُ السَّمَوَاتِ والأرْضِ ومَن فِيهِنَّ، ولَكَ الحَمْدُ أنْتَ مَلِكُ السَّمَوَاتِ والأرْضِ، ولَكَ الحَمْدُ أنْتَ الحَقُّ ووَعْدُكَ الحَقُّ، ولِقَاؤُكَ حَقٌّ، وقَوْلُكَ حَقٌّ، والجَنَّةُ حَقٌّ، والنَّارُ حَقٌّ، والنَّبِيُّونَ حَقٌّ، ومُحَمَّدٌ صَلَّى اللهُ عليه وسلَّمَ حَقٌّ، والسَّاعَةُ حَقٌّ، اللَّهُمَّ لكَ أسْلَمْتُ، وبِكَ آمَنْتُ، وعَلَيْكَ تَوَكَّلْتُ، وإلَيْكَ أنَبْتُ، وبِكَ خَاصَمْتُ، وإلَيْكَ حَاكَمْتُ، فَاغْفِرْ لي ما قَدَّمْتُ وما أخَّرْتُ، وما أسْرَرْتُ وما أعْلَنْتُ، أنْتَ المُقَدِّمُ، وأَنْتَ المُؤَخِّرُ، لا إلَهَ إلَّا أنْتَ.
(متفق عليه)

items.textEn:
Ibn ‘Abbas reported: When the Prophet ﷺ would rise during the night for prayer, he would say:
O Allah, to You belongs all praise; You are the Sustainer of the heavens and the earth and all who are in them.
To You belongs all praise; Yours is the dominion of the heavens and the earth and all who are in them.
To You belongs all praise; You are the Light of the heavens and the earth and all who are in them.
To You belongs all praise; You are the King of the heavens and the earth.
To You belongs all praise; You are the Truth, and Your promise is true, Your meeting is true, Your Word is true, Paradise is true, Hellfire is true, the Prophets are true, Muhammad ﷺ is true, and the Hour is true.
O Allah, to You I have submitted, in You I have believed, upon You I have relied, to You I have turned in repentance, and by You I argue and to You I turn for judgment.
So forgive me what I have done before and what I will do later, what I have done in secret and what I have done openly.
You are the One who brings forward and the One who delays; there is no deity except You.
items.translit:
Allahumma laka al-hamdu anta qayyimus-samawati wal-ardhi wa man fihinna,

Wa laka al-hamdu laka mulkus-samawati wal-ardhi wa man fihinna,

Wa laka al-hamdu anta nurus-samawati wal-ardhi wa man fihinna,

Wa laka al-hamdu anta malikus-samawati wal-ardh,

Wa laka al-hamdu anta al-haqqu wa wa‘duka al-haqqu wa liqa’uka haqq,

Wa qawluka haqq, wal-jannatu haqq, wan-naru haqq, wan-nabiyyuna haqq,

Wa Muhammadun sallallahu ‘alayhi wa sallama haqq, was-sa‘atu haqq,

Allahumma laka aslamtu, wa bika amantu, wa ‘alayka tawakkaltu, wa ilayka anabtu,

Wa bika khasamtu, wa ilayka hakamtu,

Faghfir li ma qaddamtu wa ma akhkhartu, wa ma asrartu wa ma a‘lantu,

Antal-muqaddimu wa antal-mu’akhkhiru, la ilaha illa ant.

segments.t: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ حُبَّكَ، وَحُبَّ مَنْ يُحِبُّكَ، وَالْعَمَلَ الَّذِي يُبَلِّغُنِي حُبَّكَ، اللَّهُمَّ اجْعَلْ حُبَّكَ أَحَبَّ إِلَيَّ مِنْ نَفْسِي، وَأَهْلِي، وَمِنَ الْمَاءِ الْبَارِدِ.
(رواه الترمذي وقال حديث حسن)

items.textEn:
O Allah, I ask You for Your love, the love of those who love You, and deeds that will bring me closer to Your love.
O Allah, make Your love dearer to me than myself, my family, and even cold water.
items.translit:
Allahumma inni as’aluka hubbak,

Wa hubba man yuhibbuk,

Wal-‘amala alladhi yuballighuni hubbak,

Allahumma aj‘al hubbaka ahabba ilayya min nafsi,

Wa ahli,

Wa minal-ma’il-barid.

segments.t: اللَّهُمَّ اكْفِنِي بِحَلَالِكَ عَنْ حَرَامِكَ، وَأَغْنِنِي بِفَضْلِكَ عَمَّنْ سِوَاكَ.
(رواه الترمذي وقال حديث حسن)

items.textEn: O Allah, suffice me with what You have made lawful against what You have made unlawful, and enrich me with Your bounty from all besides You.
items.translit:
Allahumma akfini bihalalika ‘an haramik,

Wa aghnini bifadhlika ‘amman siwak.

segments.t: اللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لِي خَطِيئَتِي وَجَهْلِي، وَإِسْرَافِي فِي أَمْرِي كُلِّهِ، وَمَا أَنْتَ أَعْلَمُ بِهِ مِنِّي، اللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لِي خَطَايَايَ، وَعَمْدِي وَجَهْلِي وَهَزْلِي، وَكُلُّ ذَلِكَ عِنْدِي، اللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لِي مَا قَدَّمْتُ وَمَا أَخَّرْتُ، وَمَا أَسْرَرْتُ وَمَا أَعْلَنْتُ، أَنْتَ الْمُقَدِّمُ وَأَنْتَ الْمُؤَخِّرُ، وَأَنْتَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ.
(متفق عليه)

items.textEn:
O Allah, forgive my mistakes, my ignorance, my excess in all my affairs, and whatever You know better than I do.
O Allah, forgive my errors, my intentional and unintentional wrongs, my seriousness and my jesting — all of that is within me.
O Allah, forgive what I have sent forward and what I have delayed, what I have done secretly and what I have done openly.
You are the One who brings forward and the One who delays, and You are over all things competent.
items.translit:
Allahumma ighfir li khati’ati wa jahli,

Wa israfi fi amri kullih,

Wa ma anta a‘lamu bihi minni,

Allahumma ighfir li khatayaya,

Wa ‘amdi wa jahli wa hazli,

Wa kullu dhalika ‘indi,

Allahumma ighfir li ma qaddamtu wa ma akhkhartu,

Wa ma asrartu wa ma a‘lantu,

Antal-muqaddimu wa antal-mu’akhkhir,

Wa anta ‘ala kulli shay’in qadir.

segments.t: اللَّهُمَّ آتِنِي الْحِكْمَةَ الَّتِي مَنْ أُوتِيَهَا فَقَدْ أُوتِيَ خَيْرًا كَثِيرًا.
قَالَ سُبْحَانَهُ وَتَعَالَى: ﴿يُؤْتِي الْحِكْمَةَ مَنْ يَشَاءُ وَمَنْ يُؤْتَ الْحِكْمَةَ فَقَدْ أُوتِيَ خَيْرًا كَثِيرًا ﴾ «البقرة»

items.textEn:
O Allah, grant me wisdom, for whoever is granted wisdom has indeed been given much good.
As Allah the Exalted said: “He grants wisdom to whom He wills, and whoever has been granted wisdom has certainly been given much good.” (Al-Baqarah 2:269)
items.translit: Allahumma atini al-hikmata allati man utiyaha faqad utiya khayran kathira.

segments.t: اللَّهُمَّ ثَبِّتْنِي وَاجْعَلْنِي هَادِيًا مَهْدِيًّا.
دَلَّ عَلَيْهِ دُعَاءُ النَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ لِجَرِيرٍ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ. (البخاري)

items.textEn: O Allah, keep me firm and make me one who guides others and is rightly guided.
items.translit:
Allahumma thabbitni,

Waj‘alni hadiyan mahdiyya.

segments.t: اللَّهُمَّ أَحْسَنْتَ خَلْقِي فَأَحْسِنْ خُلُقِي.
(رواه أحمد وصححه الألباني في إرواء الغليل)

items.textEn: O Allah, as You have made my form good, make my character good as well.
items.translit:
Allahumma ahsanta khalqi,

Fa ahsin khuluqi.

segments.t: اللَّهُمَّ زِدْنَا وَلَا تَنْقُصْنَا، وَأَكْرِمْنَا وَلَا تُهِنَّا، وَأَعْطِنَا وَلَا تَحْرِمْنَا، وَآثِرْنَا وَلَا تُؤْثِرْ عَلَيْنَا، وَارْضِنَا وَارْضَ عَنَّا.
(رواه الترمذي)

items.textEn: O Allah, increase us and do not decrease us, honor us and do not disgrace us, give us and do not withhold from us, favor us and do not favor others over us, and make us pleased and be pleased with us.
items.translit:
Allahumma zidna wa la tanqusna,

Wa akrimna wa la tuhinnna,

Wa a‘tina wa la tahrimna,

Wa athirna wa la tu’thir ‘alayna,

Wardina warda ‘anna.

segments.t: اللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لِي، وَارْحَمْنِي، وَاهْدِنِي، وَعَافِنِي، وَارْزُقْنِي.
(رواه مسلم، وفي رواية لمسلم: فإن هؤلاء تجمع لك دنياك وآخرتك، وفي سنن أبي داود قال: فلما ولى الأعرابي قال النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم: لقد ملأ يديه من الخير. "واجبرني وارفعني" ابن ماجه والترمذي)

items.textEn: O Allah, forgive me, have mercy on me, guide me, grant me well-being, and provide for me.
items.translit:
Allahumma ighfir li,

Warhamni,

Wahdini,

Wa ‘afini,

Warzuqni.

segments.t: اللَّهمَّ لَكَ الحمدُ كلُّهُ، اللَّهمَّ لا قابضَ لما بسطتَ، ولا مقرِّبَ لما باعدتَ، ولا مباعدَ لما قرَّبتَ، ولا مانعَ لما أعطيتَ، ولا معطيَ لما منعتَ, اللَّهمَّ ابسُط علينا من برَكاتِكَ، أسألُكَ النَّعيمَ المقيمَ الَّذي لا يحولُ ولا يزولُ, اللَّهمَّ عائذًا بِكَ من سوءِ ما أعطيتَنا وشرِّ ما منعتَ منَّا، اللَّهمَّ حبِّب إلينا الإيمانَ وزيِّنْهُ في قلوبنا، وَكرِّه إلينا الْكفرَ والفسوقَ والعصيانَ، واجعلنا منَ الرَّاشدينَ، اللَّهمَّ توفَّنا مسلمينَ، وأحيِنا مسلمينَ، وألحِقنا بالصَّالحينَ غيرَ خزايا ولا مفتونينَ.
(رواه أحمد بلفظه، والبخاري في الأدب المفرد، وصححه الألباني في تخريج فقه السيرة)

items.textEn:
O Allah, all praise is due to You.
O Allah, none can withhold what You give, and none can give what You withhold.
There is no guide for whom You lead astray, and no misleader for whom You guide.
None can prevent what You grant, nor grant what You prevent.
None can bring near what You distance, nor distance what You bring near.
O Allah, spread upon us Your blessings, mercy, bounty, and provision.
O Allah, I ask You for everlasting bliss which never fades nor ceases.
O Allah, I ask You for provision on the day of poverty and safety on the day of fear.
O Allah, I seek refuge in You from the evil of what You have given us and the evil of what You have withheld from us.
O Allah, make faith beloved to us and beautify it in our hearts, and make us hate disbelief, sin, and disobedience, and make us among the rightly guided.
O Allah, cause us to die as Muslims, let us live as Muslims, and join us with the righteous — not disgraced or tested.
O Allah, fight the disbelievers who deny Your messengers and hinder others from Your path.
Send upon them Your punishment and torment.
items.translit:
Allahumma laka al-hamdu kulluh,

Allahumma la qabida lima basatta,

Wa la basita lima qabadta,

Wa la hadiya liman adlalta,

Wa la mudilla liman hadayta,

Wa la mu‘tiya lima mana‘ta,

Wa la mani‘a lima a‘tayta,

Wa la muqarriba lima ba‘adta,

Wa la muba‘ida lima qarrabta,

Allahumma ibsut ‘alayna min barakatika,

Wa rahmatika,

Wa fadhlika,

Wa rizqika,

Allahumma inni as’aluka an-na‘imal-muqim alladhi la yahulu wa la yazul,

Allahumma inni as’aluka an-na‘ima yawmal-‘aylah,

Wal-amna yawmal-khawf,

Allahumma inni ‘aidhun bika min sharri ma a‘taytana wa sharri ma mana‘tana,

Allahumma habbib ilayna al-imana wa zayyinhu fi qulubina,

Wa karrih ilayna al-kufra wal-fusuqa wal-‘isyan,

Waj‘alna minar-rashidin,

Allahumma tawaffana muslimin,

Wa ahyina muslimin,

Wa alhiqna bis-salihin,

Ghayra khazaya wa la maftunin,

Allahumma qatilil-kuffarata alladhina yukadhibuna rusulak,

Wa yasudduna ‘an sabilik,

Waj‘al ‘alayhim rijzaka wa ‘adhabak,

segments.t: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ عِيشَةً نَقِيَّةً، وَمِيتَةً سَوِيَّةً، وَمَرَدًّا غَيْرَ مَخْزٍ وَلَا فَاضِحٍ.
(زوائد مسند البزار، والطبراني، وانظر: مجمع الزوائد، قال: إسناد الطبراني جيد)

items.textEn: O Allah, I ask You for a pure life, a peaceful death, and a return (to You) that brings neither disgrace nor humiliation.
items.translit:
Allahumma inni as’aluka ‘ishatan naqiyyah,

Wa mitatan sawwiyyah,

Wa maraddan ghayra makhzin wa la fadhih.

segments.t: اللَّهُمَّ إِنَّا نَسْأَلُكَ مِنْ خَيْرِ مَا سَأَلَكَ مِنْهُ نَبِيُّكَ مُحَمَّدٌ ﷺ، وَنَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا اسْتَعَاذَ مِنْهُ نَبِيُّكَ مُحَمَّدٌ ﷺ، وَأَنْتَ الْمُسْتَعَانُ، وَعَلَيْكَ الْبَلَاغُ، وَلَا حَوْلَ وَلَا قُوَّةَ إِلَّا بِاللَّهِ.
(رواه الترمذي وابن ماجه بمعناه)

items.textEn:
O Allah, we ask You for all the good that Your Prophet Muhammad ﷺ asked You for,
and we seek refuge in You from all the evil from which Your Prophet Muhammad ﷺ sought refuge.
You are the One whose help is sought, and upon You is the conveyance (of all matters). There is no power and no strength except through Allah.
items.translit:
Allahumma inna nas’aluka min khayri ma sa’alaka minhu nabiyyuka Muhammadun sallallahu ‘alayhi wa sallam,

Wa na‘udhu bika min sharri ma ista‘adha minhu nabiyyuka Muhammadun sallallahu ‘alayhi wa sallam,

Wa anta al-musta‘anu,

Wa ‘alayka al-balaghu,

Wa la hawla wa la quwwata illa billah.
